newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE sugar tightly mixed, lacks direction.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE sugar tightly mixed, lacks direction.

text.p: LIFFE sugar was tightly mixed by mid afternoon, after earlier gains were lost.
Traders said the market was lacking strong direction. "Basically it's just following New York, which isn't doing a lot," one said.
Attention is focussed on the August contract as it moves towards expiry, he said, noting some spread trading with October.
By 1507 GMT August was 10 cents up at $319.30, off a high of $320.60.
August volume so far was 1,771 lots of a total 2,767.
